data.name: Leah
data.gender_notes: Leah is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Leʾah; the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'weary' or 'delicate'. Its root is Hebrew l-ʾ-h. Leah, wife of Jacob (Genesis 29). Leah is a Hebrew name meaning “Weary; delicate”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Leah expresses “Weary; delicate”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Leʾah; the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'weary' or 'delicate'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leah total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
